candidates.description: This vector represents numeric digits or numerical values without a discernible contextual pattern.
This vector represents Asian geography, travel destinations, and Eastern spiritual traditions.
This vector represents common punctuation marks and trailing symbol combinations used at the ends of sentences or data strings.
This vector activates for words, names, and subword tokens containing the "od" or "ud" phonetic sound.
This vector represents common word endings, syllables, or subword tokens ending with nasal consonant clusters like "-ang", "-ong", and "-ng".
This vector represents capitalized and lowercase two-letter text fragments or syllable-like token prefixes.
These tokens are demonstrative pronouns and adjectives in Romance languages (primarily Portuguese, French, and Spanish) used to point out specific people, objects, or ideas in space or time.
This vector activates strongly for words, names, and name fragments starting with the letter 'K'.
This vector represents sub-word tokens containing the linguistic suffix or sound '-h' across various terms.
